quote.text: On the occasion of every accident that befalls you, remember to turn to yourself and inquire what power you have for turning it to use.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • In each stumble with your children, seek the hidden lesson; transform misfortune into guidance that nurtures growth and resilience.
    • Just as nature refines her creations in hardship, let every family challenge cultivate patience, understanding, and love.
  • Leadership:
    • Embrace setbacks as the forge of virtuous leadership; question how each trial may refine your judgment and resolve.
    • Recognize that in every unexpected event lies the seed of opportunity to inspire and direct your followers toward a higher purpose.
  • Product Management:
    • When faced with unforeseen obstacles in your projects, view them as chances to innovate—seeking within your own insight the power to reinvent and improve.
    • Treat each challenge as a moment to reassess and realign, turning errors into valuable feedback that steers your product toward excellence.
